title: Metropolitan specimen common capability contract
scope: Each named metropolitan area is a first-class specimen independent of any administrative study rectangle.

capabilities.title: Reference map and optional physical context
capabilities.expected: Region-bounded raster map selection, attribution and optional terrain imagery; geographic coverage documented per provider.

capabilities.title: Metro identity and official area definition
capabilities.expected: Stable metro identity, constituent jurisdiction references and an authority/vintage for any official metro delimitation. A camera rectangle is never an authoritative boundary.
capabilities.display: Named specimen with map study extent; explicit boundary status

capabilities.title: Planning designations and zoning
capabilities.expected: Source-provided land zoning/land-use categories with jurisdiction-specific definitions, dates, and completeness limits.
capabilities.display: Categorical polygon overlay, legend, opacity and category highlighting

capabilities.title: Population and demographic geography
capabilities.expected: Statistical geography, population totals, sex breakdown and race/ethnicity where locally appropriate and measured. Maintain denominator, vintage and uncertainty.
capabilities.display: Tract or local-equivalent choropleths, legends and queryable estimates

capabilities.title: Household income and inequality context
capabilities.expected: Income estimates by documented geographic unit; never mislabel income as wealth or omit suppression and uncertainty.
capabilities.display: Income map with fixed scales, units, survey period and missing values

capabilities.title: Parcel geometry and identifiers
capabilities.expected: Source-backed cadastral/assessor polygons, scoped stable identifiers, coverage, and vintage. Do not request personal owner data.
capabilities.display: Visible-area parcel boundaries and source IDs

capabilities.title: Land and improvement assessments
capabilities.expected: Where offered, distinct assessed land/improvement values and tax roll year. Never represent assessed values as current sale or market prices.
capabilities.display: Fixed assessed-value bands, opacity, legend and factual parcel popup

capabilities.title: Geographic retrieval, caching and verifiability
capabilities.expected: Viewport/pilot-bounded API calls, limited concurrency, policy-respecting cache, failure recovery, source registry, unit and live-browser checks.
capabilities.display: Loading/coverage/error state with documented data source provenance

optional_future_capabilities.title: Household net worth or validated wealth proxies

consistency_rules: Every metro is evaluated against all required capability IDs.
Same feature meaning and evidence standard, not forced identical providers or measurement methods.
Document partial geographic coverage and unavailable data explicitly.
Metro study bounds cannot be mistaken for an authoritative metro delimitation.
No specimen queue mutation implies source downloads or downstream task execution.
